full_source_reviews.title: What LLM Forecasters Know but Don't Say: Probing Internal Representations for Calibration and Faithfulness
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1; author experiments, no immutable public artifact located

method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08046v1#S3 — activation extraction, lightweight probes, datasets and metrics
evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08046v1#S4 — temperature/rollout calibration, math OOD, chain-of-thought faithfulness, forced answering and pre-reasoning triage
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08046v1#S5 — discussion and bounded implications; probe readability, benchmark transfer and causal use remain unproved
locators.artifact: No author repository linked in exact v1

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Read a confidence-related signal from internal activations before or during generation, then use a separately calibrated probe to route among answer, reason, retrieve or abstain; verbalized confidence remains a distinct output channel.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Asking the model to state confidence is cheap and black-box compatible, but instruction-following and fluent rationalization can suppress or distort information present in hidden state.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Probes can expose signal unavailable in self-report, but require model access, layer/representation identity and slice-specific calibration. Decodability does not prove that the base model uses the signal, that it is causal, or that it transfers across checkpoints/domains.

benchmark_contract.model: EF-8B forecaster plus paper-listed probe/model variants
benchmark_contract.hardware: Not disclosed as a portable systems contract
benchmark_contract.output_length: 10 rollouts at each of 10 temperatures for 296 forecasting questions (29,600 generations); task-dependent elsewhere
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: Offline experiments; not a serving benchmark
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Calibration/faithfulness evidence on the reported models and tasks; no universal introspective confidence claim

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: No mechanism patch. Ch5 already separates probe readability from causal use, while Ch66 already separates self-report, behavioral evidence and calibrated uncertainty. If retained, add only a review note tying the experiment to those existing boundaries.

full_source_reviews.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact survey v1 plus event-time bibliography artifact; taxonomy evidence, not new performance evidence

evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08057v1#S5 — survey comparison tables; no new controlled benchmark
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08057v1#Sx1 — omissions and workload-coupled speedup caveats

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Classify KV optimization by which state is changed: when cache work executes, where state is placed/moved, and how representation or retention is reduced; then evaluate combinations against the same workload and cache identity.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: A single-method view was adequate for one bottleneck, but long-context, prefix reuse, disaggregation and heterogeneous tiers couple compute, bandwidth, placement and fidelity decisions.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: The taxonomy improves design reasoning but does not establish compatibility or portable speedup. Survey completeness drifts, and combining independently reported numbers violates benchmark identity.

benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Taxonomy and literature map only; no aggregate benchmark conclusion

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: No patch. Ch45, Ch47 and Ch53 already separate KV identity, paging/placement, compression and tiering; the survey is useful corroboration rather than a missing mechanism.

full_source_reviews.title: MORES: Mobile Reasoning-as-a-Service via Distributed LLM Inference-Time Scaling
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1 plus event-time repository; author simulation/benchmark evidence

method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08116v1#S3 — device prelude/coda and server recurrent reasoning units
https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08116v1#S5 — semantic router and joint resource control
evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08116v1#S6 — GSM8K, MBPP, HellaSwag and resource-allocation experiments
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08116v1#S6 — conclusion and remaining deployment boundary; simulation assumptions, partition compatibility, privacy and real mobile energy/tail behavior remain open

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Split a reasoning process into device-side prelude/coda and server-side recurrent reasoning units, then jointly route semantic work and wireless/compute resources rather than treating network placement as a fixed model split.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: All-local inference preserves privacy and availability but is compute/energy bound; full remote serving is operationally simple but pays radio latency, connectivity and disclosure cost. Iterative reasoning makes this placement decision recur across latent steps.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Joint routing can adapt to channel and server load, but creates latent-state transfer identity, privacy, partition-compatibility and failure-recovery obligations. Simulation gains and a near-oracle router do not prove handset energy, radio tail or production reliability.

benchmark_contract.hardware: NVIDIA A100 80GB server, Intel Xeon 8375C; mobile side modeled
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: DRL K=100 requests; reported channel/resource settings
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Reported benchmark and wireless simulation only

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch52: add the experimental branch from one-time model offload to iterative latent-state placement. Preserve the boundaries that the paper supplies simulation/author benchmark evidence, while real handset energy, privacy, radio-tail behavior and failure recovery remain unproved.

full_source_reviews.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1; linked repository had no commit at or before the report cutoff, so implementation is not accepted as event-time evidence

method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08716v1#S3 — two-phase bank management and selective intervention
ablation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08716v1#S4.SS3 — full bank, advisor-only and always-on intervention controls
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08716v1#S5 — conclusion and bounded evidence; benchmark scope, memory authority and false-reminder risk remain open

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Separate memory maintenance from intervention: a memory agent turns trajectory evidence into a structured bank, then owns the control decision to remain silent or inject a concise, grounded reminder when future failure risk justifies Context cost.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Passive retrieval is reasonable when the acting agent knows when to ask. Long-horizon tasks fail when relevant evidence is not queried at the right step; exposing the whole bank or an always-on advisor avoids misses but adds distraction and unsupported advice.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Selective intervention reduces persistent Context pressure and can preempt repeated mistakes, but adds a learned control policy that can interrupt too often, stay silent at critical points, or generate reminders not grounded in authoritative memory. Bank provenance, reminder citation, abstention and intervention-cost metrics are required; passive retrieval remains preferable for short or deterministic workflows.

benchmark_contract.hardware: Provider/runtime dependent; not a hardware benchmark
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: Per-task agent runs; not disclosed as serving concurrency
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Author benchmark and ablations; no proof of universal memory policy, production authorization or concurrent-state correctness

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch77, after Memory Read: add evolution passive pull -> always-visible/always-on memory -> separate maintained bank and selective intervention. Define the intervention controller as owner of timing, not truth; require reminder-to-memory provenance, silence/false-intervention metrics and an always-off fallback. Preserve passive retrieval for short, predictable tasks.

full_source_reviews.title: The Illusion of Equivalency: Statistical Characterization of Quantization Effects in LLMs
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1 author experiments; no immutable author implementation artifact located

method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08734v1#S3 — attention-distribution divergence and behavioral agreement metrics
evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08734v1#S4 — four models, llama.cpp quantizers, perplexity and zero-shot tasks
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08734v1#S5 — discussion and bounded implications; no universal safe-bit threshold
locators.artifact: llama.cpp is the quantizer implementation reference; paper-specific Python is described but no public immutable artifact is linked

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Evaluate quantization as a possible behavioral transformation, not only a storage reduction: compare internal distribution shift and per-example correctness agreement alongside aggregate perplexity/accuracy.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Aggregate quality metrics were adequate when acceptance only asked whether average task score stayed stable. Production routing, reproducibility and safety need to know whether individual decisions changed even when the aggregate is flat.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Agreement and distribution diagnostics expose hidden drift but increase evaluation cost and remain task/model dependent. The reported Q4/Q3/Q2 transition is not a universal precision law; calibration must be repeated per checkpoint, quantizer, hardware/runtime and workload slice.

benchmark_contract.precision: llama.cpp Q8_0/Q5_0/Q4_0 and Q6_K through Q2_K
benchmark_contract.input_length: WikiText-2/C4 and zero-shot task prompts; variable
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: These four models, quantizers and datasets only

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch49 quantization acceptance: add aggregate metric stability -> per-example agreement/distribution diagnostics -> slice-specific release gate. Explicitly reject universal bit-width safety thresholds and hand calibration evidence to Ch66.

full_source_reviews.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1 recovered; author benchmark, no public repository URL located in the manuscript

method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08758v1#S3 — Idea Genome, GenomeDiff and operational lineage dynamics
ablation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08758v1#S10 — setting, budget and evaluator diagnostics
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08758v1#S9 — operational dynamics are not exhaustive; mixed lineages and evaluation/model-judge limits remain
locators.artifact: No author repository or immutable benchmark release located in exact v1

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Represent scientific lineage with typed inherited components and explicit deltas, then evaluate both lineage understanding and whether generated proposals remain grounded in those inherited mechanisms rather than merely sharing a topic ecology.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Topical similarity and citation proximity are cheap discovery tools, but cannot distinguish direct mechanism inheritance, alternative branches and coincidental shared context.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Typed lineage improves auditability but depends on expert annotation, an operational rather than exhaustive taxonomy, and model judges. Mixed ancestry and ambiguous contribution boundaries can make a single genome/diff misleading.

benchmark_contract.output_length: Generation cap and invalid/empty-output handling are evaluator identity; exact cap reported in protocol
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: 42 IG-Exam task types/1,029 instances and 30 IG-Arena tasks/10 domains/1,260 proposals; not general scientific novelty

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: No Books patch. The repository already uses typed Direct Evolution/Alternative Branch/Principle Reuse relations and Ch66 already owns evaluator identity and judge limits. Keep as methodological corroboration, not a new scientific-truth mechanism.

full_source_reviews.title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1 plus event-time repository commit; benchmark evidence only

evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08768v1#S4 — 400 bilingual tasks, capability categories and model/framework comparisons
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08768v1#S5 — framework coupling and simulator/evaluator imperfection

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Evaluate proactive agents in a fresh, observable environment while separating executor, hidden rubric-bearing supervisor and a user simulator restricted to visible trajectory/status; rewrite feedback to prevent reference-answer leakage.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Static QA or final-answer benchmarks were reasonable for answer generation. Proactive agents choose whether and how to act, alter environment state and may exploit evaluator hints, so trajectory, hidden criteria and leakage boundaries become part of the test contract.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Role separation improves control and diagnosis but simulators/judges remain model-dependent and can leak, misread hidden state or reward framework quirks. Fresh containers improve isolation but do not make dynamic external services deterministic.

benchmark_contract.model: 10 executor models under OpenClaw v2026.3.11; selected models also under Nanobot/EDICT
benchmark_contract.hardware: Task containers/services; provider compute not standardized
benchmark_contract.slo: Task timeout exists; no serving SLO
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Benchmark/framework/evaluator contract; 50-trajectory human check reports 92% binary agreement, not universal judge reliability

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: No mechanism patch. Ch66 already requires hidden criteria, visible-trajectory boundaries, simulator separation, environment identity and disagreement audit; Agent chapters hand trajectories to this owner.

full_source_reviews.title: BlockServe: Block-Grained Continuous Batching for High-Throughput Diffusion LLM Serving
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1 author experiments; no public implementation artifact located

method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08930v1#S2 — block-cycle scheduling, mixed-state layout and token-budget admission
evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08930v1#S3 — two diffusion LMs, four benchmarks and baseline comparison
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08930v1#S5 — evidence is limited to offline batching; online arrivals remain future work
locators.artifact: No author repository or immutable implementation linked in exact v1

full_source_reviews.mechanism: Change the continuous-batching quantum from an autoregressive token iteration to a diffusion block-denoise cycle. Reclaim completed block slots immediately, align requests at heterogeneous denoising states in one dense layout, and admit work under a token/memory bounding box.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Static batching and token-level iteration scheduling are reasonable for synchronized forward calls or autoregressive decode. Diffusion LMs repeatedly refine blocks, and requests converge at different block boundaries, creating stragglers and heterogeneous mutable state that token-level scheduling cannot represent.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Finer blocks improve reclamation but add scheduling/denoising overhead; larger blocks improve efficiency but can amplify parallel-decoding approximation and reduce quality. Mixed-state layouts and token budgets add metadata/kernel complexity. Offline batches on one H200 do not establish online tail latency, arrival fairness or multi-GPU behavior; AR iteration scheduling remains right for AR models.

benchmark_contract.output_length: 256/512 in throughput tables and fixed 1024 for safe-capacity test
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: Offline batch sizes and maximum safe capacity; default block length/steps L=32, S=32
benchmark_contract.slo: No online arrival or tail-SLO evaluation
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: 1.9-10.6x throughput and 2-4x capacity only against reported baselines/configurations; not portable

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch46 after iteration-work definition: add an Alternative Branch showing AR token iteration -> diffusion block-denoise cycle -> block-grained reclamation/mixed-state packing -> online-arrival pressure. State that generation semantics defines the scheduling quantum; block length trades scheduler overhead against approximation quality. Handoff dLLM semantics to Ch24 and preserve AR scheduling as coexisting branch.

full_source_reviews.title: SiFAR: Synchronization-Free All-Reduce for Low-Latency LLM Inference
full_source_reviews.evidence_level: Exact paper v1 author experiments; no author implementation artifact located

method: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08973v1#S3 — dual buffering and redundant pull
https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08973v1#S4 — speculate, verify and retry collective protocol
evaluation: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08973v1#S5 — microbenchmarks and Megakernel end-to-end results
limitations: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08973v1#S9 — H200/NVSwitch, small-payload low-batch and Megakernel scope boundaries
locators.artifact: No author repository linked; cited TensorRT-LLM/NCCL/DeepEP are references, not SiFAR implementation evidence

full_source_reviews.mechanism: For small-payload low-batch TP decode, remove the bottom barrier with dual buffers, reduce transfer with switch-assisted redundant pull, and replace the top readiness barrier with speculative fetch plus a reduced validation flag; retry on mis-speculation before committing the collective result.
full_source_reviews.old_solution_and_constraint_change: Oneshot/twoshot barriers and communication-compute overlap are reasonable at larger batches where compute hides communication. Latency-sensitive reasoning/agent decode minimizes batching; there is too little compute to hide collectives and barrier time dominates small payloads.
full_source_reviews.tradeoff_and_failure_modes: Speculation avoids flag exchange when ranks progress nearly together, but needs extra buffers, validation state and a retry path; imbalance raises retries. Switch reduction and Megakernel integration bind portability to topology/runtime. Correctness depends on buffer generation and validation ordering, not merely matching final tokens; conventional collectives remain safer on unsupported fabrics or larger/asynchronous workloads.

benchmark_contract.hardware: one 8×NVIDIA H200 system with the evaluated interconnect/switch path
benchmark_contract.precision: FP8 model execution in reported end-to-end setup
benchmark_contract.input_length: Headline end-to-end contract ISL=1000; a separate sensitivity sweep extends context to 16K
benchmark_contract.output_length: Headline end-to-end contract OSL=1000; TPOT/token-throughput sensitivity is reported separately
benchmark_contract.batch_or_concurrency: Headline TP=8 on one 8×H200 system; low-batch BS=1 to 256 sensitivity is a separate experiment
benchmark_contract.slo: Optimizes TPOT; no production P99 SLO
benchmark_contract.claim_boundary: Up to 52% All-Reduce latency and 18.6%/13.1% throughput only in the reported H200 Megakernel contracts; no cross-fabric claim

full_source_reviews.books_patch_proposal: Ch49 collective execution section: add low-batch branch overlap/fusion -> barrier-dominated collective -> dual-buffer generation -> speculate/verify/retry. Make validation flag and retry part of correctness/commit, bind applicability to small payloads and supported switch/runtime, and hand TP semantics back to Ch36 without moving inference execution ownership there.
